description: Roll on this table when an event calls for a Life Event.

2.description: Sickness or Injury: You are injured or become sick. Roll on the Injury table.

3.description: Birth or Death: Someone close to you dies, like a friend or family member. Alternatively, someone close to you gives birth (or is born!). You are involved in some fashion (father or mother, relative, godparent, etc).

effects.prompt: Someone close to you dies, or someone close to you gives birth. Describe what happened and your involvement.

4.description: Ending of Relationship: A romantic relationship involving you ends. Badly.

effects.prompt: A romantic relationship ends badly. Gain a Rival or Enemy.

5.description: Improved Relationship: A romantic relationship involving you deepens, possibly leading to marriage or some other emotional commitment. Gain an Ally.

6.description: New Relationship: You become involved in a romantic relationship. Gain an Ally.

7.description: New Contact: You gain a new Contact.

8.description: Betrayal: You are betrayed in some fashion by a friend. If you have any Contacts or Allies, convert one into a Rival or Enemy. Otherwise, gain a Rival or an Enemy.

effects.prompt: You are betrayed by a friend. Gain a Rival or Enemy (or convert an existing Contact or Ally).

9.description: Travel: You move to another world. You gain DM+2 to your next Qualification roll.

effects.prompt: You move to another world. You gain DM+2 to your next Qualification roll. Describe where you went and why.

10.description: Good Fortune: Something good happens to you; you come into money unexpectedly, have a lifelong dream come true, get a book published or have some other stroke of good fortune. Gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.

11.description: Crime: You commit or are the victim (or are accused) of a crime. Lose one Benefit roll or take the Prisoner career in your next term.

effects.prompt: You are involved in a crime.

options.label: Take the Prisoner career next term

12.description: Unusual Event: Something weird happens. Roll 1D to determine what.

effects.prompt: Something unusual happens. What is it?

options.label: Psionics: You encounter a Psionic institute

effect.prompt: You encounter a Psionic institute. You may immediately test your Psionic Strength and, if you qualify, take the Psion career in your next term.

options.label: Aliens: You spend time among an alien race. Gain Science 1 and a Contact
Alien Artefact: You have a strange and unusual device from an alien culture
Amnesia: Something happened to you, but you do not know what it was

effect.prompt: Something happened to you, but you do not know what it was. Describe the gaps in your memory.

options.label: Contact with Government: You briefly came into contact with the highest echelons of the Imperium

effect.prompt: You briefly came into contact with the highest echelons of the Imperium. Describe the encounter.

options.label: Ancient Technology: You have something older than the Imperium
